cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_gsf C)

# libgsf is autotools-only; no upstream CMake config. Use CMakeDeps
# generated by conan to locate libgsf-1 (via pkg-config bridge under the
# hood) + forward-declare transitive deps.
#
# Team registry versions (mirrors pidgin 2.14.14's CMakeLists.txt approach):
#   - glib/2.84.0   → aggregate target glib::glib
#   - libxml2/2.15.3 → LibXml2::LibXml2 (case-sensitive)
#   - zlib/1.3.1     → ZLIB::ZLIB (case-sensitive)
find_package(libgsf-1 REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(glib REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(LibXml2 REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)

add_executable(test_gsf test_gsf.c)
target_link_libraries(test_gsf
    libgsf-1::libgsf-1
    glib::glib
    LibXml2::LibXml2
    ZLIB::ZLIB
)

# Same conan 2.x GLOB-fallback pattern as pidgin's CMakeLists.txt L60-220:
# in case any dep fails to expose INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES via
# CMakeDeps, add include dirs explicitly from the conan cache layout.
if(NOT DEFINED CONAN_HOME)
    if(DEFINED ENV{CONAN_HOME})
        set(CONAN_HOME $ENV{CONAN_HOME})
    elseif(DEFINED ENV{HOME})
        set(CONAN_HOME $ENV{HOME}/.conan2)
    else()
        set(CONAN_HOME "")
    endif()
endif()

# glib needs include/glib-2.0 (glib.h) and lib/glib-2.0/include (glibconfig.h).
# zlib needs include/.
# libxml2 needs include/libxml2/libxml/ (xmlversion.h).
# libgsf needs include/libgsf-1/gsf/ (gsf.h).
file(GLOB _GLIB_H
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/glib*/p/include/glib-2.0/glib.h"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/glib*/p/include/glib-2.0/glib.h")
file(GLOB _GLIB_CFG
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/glib*/p/lib/glib-2.0/include/glibconfig.h"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/glib*/p/lib/glib-2.0/include/glibconfig.h")
file(GLOB _LIBGSF_H
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/gsf*/p/include/libgsf-1/gsf/gsf.h"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/gsf*/p/include/libgsf-1/gsf/gsf.h")

foreach(_var IN ITEMS _GLIB_H _GLIB_CFG _LIBGSF_H)
    set(_VAL "${${_var}}")
    if(_VAL STREQUAL "")
        message(WARNING "test_gsf: GLOB ${_var} empty — skipping include-dir fallback")
        continue()
    endif()
    string(FIND "${_VAL}" ";" _SEMI)
    if(_SEMI GREATER_EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "test_gsf: ${_var} matched multiple files: ${_VAL}")
    endif()
    get_filename_component(_DIR "${_VAL}" DIRECTORY)
    target_include_directories(test_gsf PRIVATE "${_DIR}")
endforeach()

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME test_gsf COMMAND test_gsf)
